description: The page's own: hand work to the agent. Returns a marker for the top of the prompt; the worker finds the agent's session by it and publishes what the agent is doing as status.agent.

oneOf.description: The project is not in iii cloud yet.

request_schema.description: `iii-cloud::handoff` input: the page hands work to the agent.

candidate.description: true when sent from the add-project steps: brief the folder being added.

text.description: The plain chat text the page would post. With it, a follow-up goes into the agent's existing chat: the worker sends it itself.

request_schema.title: HandoffRequest

asks.description: With `reused`: the agent has a real ask of its own open. Nothing was delivered, not even the page's `text` (it would read as the answer): the person answers in the chat.

delivered.description: False: nothing was sent; the page starts a new chat with the marker.

marker.description: A short line the page puts at the top of the prompt; the worker finds the agent's session by it.

reused.description: True: an equal hand-off was already open (a double click), and this is it.

sent.description: With `reused`: the worker sent the open hand-off's agent on (the same "continue" as after a person's check: the newest check's blocking problems of the agent's, and its failed run). False: nothing was sent (it works, asks the person something, or has nothing open). Absent for a new hand-off.

session_id.description: The existing chat the worker sent the hand-off into.
